title: DSPlacer: DSP Placement for FPGA-based CNN Accelerator
problem: FPGA-based CNN accelerator placement suffers from timing closure challenges; DSP placement directly impacts clock frequency and throughput but lacks automated optimization.
motivation: CNN acceleration on FPGAs requires extracting performance from limited DSP resources through optimal placement to achieve timing closure at higher frequencies.
method: DSPlacer automatically places digital signal processors (specialized arithmetic units on FPGAs) for fast CNN execution, refining the placement iteratively. Each iteration: a graph neural network identifies which processors are needed and how they connect; cost optimization assigns them to physical FPGA locations; and mathematical constraint solving ensures connected processor groups follow layout rules that prevent timing violations.
key_novelty: DSPlacer automatically places digital signal processors on FPGAs by combining neural network identification, cost optimization, and constraint solving—a first for CNN accelerator timing optimization.
contributions: Min-cost-flow based DSP assignment to compact layout
32% WNS improvement vs Vivado 2020.2, 65% vs AMF-Placer 2.0
